question: How much cash did Apple generate in FY2023, and how did it return it to shareholders?

answer.summary: In FY2023, Apple generated $110.54B in net cash provided by operating activities (XBRL-tagged) [F00224], yielding free cash flow of $99.58B after $10.96B in capital expenditures (XBRL-tagged outflow) [F00236]. The company returned $92.58B to shareholders, consisting of $77.55B in common stock repurchases (XBRL-tagged outflow) [F00251] and $15.03B in dividends (XBRL-tagged outflow) [F00248]. These returns represented 93.0% of free cash flow [F01451]. Liquidity remained strong with cash, cash equivalents and unrestricted marketable securities totaling $148.3B as of September 30, 2023 (prose) [T00350]. However, total net sales decreased 3% or $11.0B during 2023 compared to 2022 (prose) [T00275].
